description: This file defines the IncludeTokenParser class in the Twig templating engine, responsible for parsing 'include' tags in Twig templates.

classes.name: Twig\TokenParser\IncludeTokenParser
classes.description: Parser class for handling 'include' tags in Twig templates.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the include tag and returns an IncludeNode.

methods.name: parseArguments
methods.description: Parses optional arguments of the include tag such as 'ignore missing', variables, and 'only'.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name this parser handles, which is 'include'.
